description:
Become the pilot humanity needs in Gundam Rogue Orbit, a new high-mobility mecha action game from Bandai Namco Studios. Set within a brand-new timeline in the Gundam saga, ace pilot RE-X enters the cockpit of the powerful Gundam Helix and joins a ragtag crew of soldiers fighting against an unknown threat to humanity.

Battle through sprawling environments filled with enemy hordes, massive bosses and explosive mobile suit combat in a cinematic sci-fi story built around survival, sacrifice and humanity’s final stand.
